verdict.rationale: The SDK supports parallel subagents for running multiple analyses at once, agent teams for coordinating multiple Claude instances on shared work, and built-in tools (run commands, custom tools, MCP) that can script bulk actions across files/APIs — all of which enable bulk/automation-depth workflows. However, there's no dedicated 'batch operation' primitive or example (e.g., built-in map-over-items API) documented. missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk-processing API or worked example demonstrating operations across many items, independent hands-on evidence of bulk-scale reliability.
